## Purpose
The graph RAG package. Documents a user uploads are retrieved two ways: Mistral's document library (semantic search, through the built-in `document_library` tool) and a Neo4j knowledge graph extracted from the same text. Nothing reaches the graph without human approval.

## Responsibilities
The docstring describes the design:
- the library is strong on "what does it say";
- the graph is strong on traversal ("who is connected to whom");
- extraction produces a draft that a person edits, and only `commit` writes nodes.
